aunt_zhang_analysis.name: System Analysis
aunt_zhang_analysis.text: The only income source of Aunt Zhang is <yellow>cash transactions</yellow>.

aunt_zhang_analysis.name: System Analysis
aunt_zhang_analysis.text: However, when analysis the reputation of customers, 85% of the income source data is from online payment platforms (e.g., Alipay/WeChat/Credit Cards).

aunt_zhang_analysis.name: System Analysis
aunt_zhang_analysis.text: The sample data does not contain cash-users data, causing data collection to overlook the 'cash-using population'.

aunt_zhang_analysis.name: System Analysis
aunt_zhang_analysis.text: As a result, the model is totally 'blind' to Aunt Zhang's financial stability,

aunt_zhang_analysis.name: System Analysis
aunt_zhang_analysis.text: mistakenly flagging her as a high-risk individual with no income.
